objective: Minimize speed-camera false negatives. Prefer a tolerable extra alert over silently missing a plausible speed camera.

physicalClustering.policy: cluster_for_duplicate-audio control only; preserve every source record and evaluate member direction before de-duplication

runtimeFailSafe.ambiguousRoadMatch: continue temporal tracking then fallback; never discard solely because OSM confidence is low
runtimeFailSafe.ambiguousDirection: do not hard-filter unless direction_hard_filter=1; otherwise use live trajectory and soft evidence
runtimeFailSafe.osmMissing: keep speed camera eligible for trajectory fallback
runtimeFailSafe.outsideKoreaCoordinate: quarantine from automatic alert and surface in build report

validationPrinciple: A production candidate must explain every source speed camera: road-primary, fallback-required, or quarantined for objectively invalid coordinates. No silent drops.
